purpose: Browser-ready derivatives of the user's unchanged models/ source assets.
processing: Meshoptimizer 0.22 simplification with locked borders and maximum normalized error 0.007; unused vertices removed; Sharp texture resize to at most 1024x1024; opaque textures JPEG quality84 and transparent textures PNG. Sitting driver keeps original geometry, skeleton and animation. Its legacy specular-glossiness diffuse material is mapped to core glTF metallic-roughness material.
forward: +Z in source; Character applies Y rotation PI to face boat-local -Z.
